verdict.rationale: Morph publishes a first-party coding-agents guide. It covers pointing Claude Code at its native Anthropic Messages endpoint and giving Codex an `edit_file` tool backed by morph-v3-fast. A separate MCP guide connects AI tools to Fast Apply and WarpGrep, and a goose author reports using it in practice. Missing for 10: documented integration guides for agent frameworks (e.g. SDK/framework-specific setups) beyond the OpenAI-SDK base-URL note, and broader independent corroboration of the guided agent integrations.
